title: Zapier vs. Celigo: Which is best for enterprise automation? [2026]
summary: I spent time researching and testing both platforms to evaluate how each handles different aspects of enterprise automation. Here's a full comparison.
body_markdown:
**Zapier**


**Celigo**


**Ease of use**


Zapier's no-code platform, templates, and AI copilot make it simple for anyone to build workflows, agents, and apps


Built for NetSuite admins, integration architects, and developers; requires technical expertise


**Implementation time**


Hours to days


Weeks to months; requires dedicated developers


**Enterprise security**


SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, CCPA, SSO, audit logs, unified admin center with granular permissions


SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA, SSO, audit logs, HIPAA, on-premise agents


**Platform scope**


Workflows, agents, tables, forms, process mapping, MCP server, AI assistant


Flow Builder focused on enterprise integrations; MCP server


**Pricing**


Task-based pricing starting at $19.99/month for solo users and $69/month for teams of up to 25 users; custom enterprise pricing


Mid-five figures annually; custom pricing based on endpoints and workflows


**Integrations**


9,000+


apps; connections are automatically maintained


1,000+ connectors focused on NetSuite ecosystem, eCommerce, retail, logistics, and finance
